text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired: INC12345 — SLO inference.latency.p99 (us-west) exceeded 500ms (current ~620ms). Auto-page sent to oncall rotation. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC12345
sasha: acked on PD (INC12345) — taking first pass, triage now.
michael: on it, pulling hotpath traces and autoscaler logs.
sasha: quick look — sidecar queue depth jumped around 03:11:57, tokenizer backlog ramping.
opsbot: Alert: tokenizer-sidecar-7 cpu=94% (1m avg), GC pause spikes observed.
jenn: can we route novel requests to model-b-quantized temporarily? /cc @carol
sasha: initiating route fallback to model-b-quantized for streaming route, holding 30s to observe.
pagerduty: INC12345 acknowledged by sasha.
carol: posting status update to status.redwood.ai: investigating latency spike in us-west :rotating_light:
jenn: scaling tokenizer pool +2 replicas (manual request issued).
opsbot: Autoscaler: scale-up requested for tokenizer-pool, replicas -> pending.
sasha: going to temporarily suppress PD noisy repeats for 10m to avoid cascade, note added.
michael: prioritizing prefix/KV warmup on affected prefixes — pre-warming 5 hot prefixes now.
sasha: p99 trending down, p95 still elevated; keeping mitigation in place.
jenn: new replicas ready, tokeniser cpu now 48% — sidecar load decreasing.
carol: customer impact check: subset of streaming sessions in us-west saw added 200-400ms latency; no client errors reported.
sasha: plan: keep route fallback and extra replicas for another 10m, un-suppress PD if p99 < 500ms for 5m straight.
michael: adding runbook snippet for follow-up checks:
```bash
# check recent GC spikes and scale status
kubectl logs -n inference tokenizer-sidecar-7 --since=10m | grep -i GC
kubectl get hpa -n inference tokenizer-pool -o wide
kubectl scale deploy/tokenizer-pool -n inference --replicas=6
```
opsbot: Note added to INC12345 by sasha: "scaled tokenizer pool, route fallback active, observing p99 drop".
carol: handing off to second oncall @dileep for continued monitoring and postmortem ownership (dileep, you're up).
dileep: ack — monitoring, will open postmortem if we see recurrence.
sasha: thanks — closing active mitigation steps, leaving follow-up TODO to run perf regression eval against current workload.
pagerduty: INC12345 resolved by sasha (duration 00:18:23).
carol: Follow-up: created postmortem tracking task /tasks/INC12345-root-cause assigned to eng-runtime. Please capture metrics, hot prefix list, and any recent deploys.
